title: emwa-world-heavyweight
label: John Girder

won.source: the Dreamcard V card and the FWF's own singles ledger

how: The EMWA's own champion when the belt was put against the FWF World Championship at Dreamcard V.
note: The Dreamcard V match itself did not change hands: the FWF's own ledger records Doctor Death winning by disqualification. By October 1992 the FWF was billing Girder "at least former" EMWA World Champion, and nothing held says who took it or when.

title: emwa-intercontinental
label: Brewster Cogburn

won.source: The community's own 1996 Hall of Fame record, crediting the win during Cogburn's 1990-94 EMWA-era run without a specific date.

note: The only EMWA Intercontinental reign this project holds any record of; both its start and its end are undated in the sole surviving (third-party) source.
